description: Manages interactions, sessions, and data processing capabilities related to the Gemini AI assistant, including chat, file analysis, data processing, and semantic search functionalities.

exampleCriteria.description: Specify the entity type to search within.
Provide a natural language query for semantic search.
Set the minimum similarity score for results (0.0 to 1.0).
Apply structured filtering using a JSON array of field, operator, and value.
Filter by a date range using 'between' operator.

endpoints.name: GetUserSessions
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all chat sessions associated with the current user for the AI assistant.
example_uses: Show me my past AI chat sessions.
List all my conversations with the AI assistant.
Can I see my chat history with Gemini?
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user wants to view their historical interactions or a list of their saved conversations with the AI assistant.

endpoints.name: GetSessionDetails
endpoints.description: Fetches detailed information and the full transcript for a specific AI assistant chat session.

req.description: Request object containing the session identifier.

example_uses: Get details for session ID 'abc-123'.
Show me the full conversation for my last chat.
Retrieve the content of session 'xyz'.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user needs to access the full transcript or specific details of a particular AI chat session.

endpoints.name: ChatWithGemini
endpoints.description: Initiates a new chat conversation or continues an existing one with the Gemini AI assistant, allowing users to send messages and receive AI responses.

req.description: Request object containing the user's message and session context.

example_uses: Start a new conversation with the AI.
Ask the AI assistant about project timelines.
Continue our discussion about budget allocation.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user wants to interact conversationally with the AI assistant, either starting a new chat or continuing an existing one.

endpoints.name: ScanFile
endpoints.description: Submits a file to the Gemini AI for content analysis, processing, or extraction of information.

req.description: Request object containing the file data or reference for scanning.

example_uses: Scan this document for key information.
Analyze the attached report.
Process the data in this file.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user needs the AI to process or extract information from a file, such as a document or spreadsheet.

endpoints.name: ProcessDataRelatedSummaryDetails
endpoints.description: Processes provided data using the Gemini AI to generate summaries, detailed reports, or specific insights.

req.description: Request object containing the data to be processed and instructions for summarization/detail generation.

example_uses: Summarize the project data.
Generate a detailed report from the provided figures.
Process the financial data for a summary.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user wants the AI to perform data processing to create summaries or detailed reports from structured or unstructured data.

endpoints.name: UpdateAiAssistantAccessibility
endpoints.description: Updates the accessibility settings for the AI assistant, such as enabling screen reader support or adjusting display preferences.

req.description: Request object containing the accessibility settings to be updated.

example_uses: Change the AI assistant's accessibility options.
Enable screen reader support for the AI.
Adjust the AI assistant's display settings.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user needs to modify how the AI assistant interacts with accessibility features to better suit their needs.

endpoints.name: UpdateSessionStar
endpoints.description: Marks or unmarks an AI assistant chat session as 'starred' or 'favorite' for easy identification and retrieval.

req.description: Request object containing the session ID and the star status (true/false).

example_uses: Star this important chat session.
Mark session '123' as a favorite.
Unstar the current conversation.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user wants to mark a specific chat session as important or for quick access later.

endpoints.name: UpdateSessionArchive
endpoints.description: Archives or unarchives an AI assistant chat session, moving it to or from an archived state.

req.description: Request object containing the session ID and the archive status (true/false).

example_uses: Archive this old chat session.
Move session '456' to the archive.
Unarchive the conversation about the new policy.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user wants to move a chat session to or from an archived state, typically for organization or to hide less relevant conversations.

endpoints.name: UpdateSessionTitle
endpoints.description: Updates the custom title of an AI assistant chat session.

req.description: Request object containing the session ID and the new title.

example_uses: Rename this chat session to 'Project Alpha Discussion'.
Change the title of session '789'.
Update the conversation title.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user wants to give a more descriptive or personalized title to a chat session for better organization.

endpoints.name: GenerateAndStoreEmbeddings
endpoints.description: Triggers the generation and storage of vector embeddings for a specified entity. These embeddings are used to power semantic and similarity search capabilities.

entityName.description: The name of the entity for which to generate embeddings (e.g., 'Partners', 'Contacts').

example_uses: Generate embeddings for all partners.
Update embeddings for contact records.
Create vector representations for the 'Projects' entity.
endpoints.when_to_use: When new data is added or existing data is updated for an entity, and its semantic search capabilities need to be refreshed or initialized.

endpoints.name: BulkUpload
endpoints.description: Facilitates the bulk upload of data into the system for processing or ingestion. This is typically used for large datasets.

req.description: Request object containing the bulk data to be uploaded, often in a structured format.

example_uses: Perform a bulk upload of new user data.
Import multiple records from a file.
Upload a batch of financial transactions.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a large volume of data needs to be imported into the system efficiently, rather than individual record creation.

endpoints.name: AnalyseFile
endpoints.description: Analyzes an uploaded file to prepare it for import or further processing, often involving validation or schema detection.

request.description: Request object containing the file data or reference for analysis.

example_uses: Analyze the uploaded CSV file.
Prepare the Excel document for import.
Check the structure of the data file.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a file has been uploaded and needs to be pre-processed, validated, or its structure analyzed before full ingestion or processing.

endpoints.name: GetSimilarityResultAsync
endpoints.description: Performs a semantic or similarity search across specified entities, with results filtered by Role-Based Access Control (RBAC). This endpoint supports advanced search criteria using the 'whereCondition' parameter, which accepts a JSON array of field, operator, and value objects. Available operators include 'like', 'is', 'not', 'contains', 'startsWith', and 'between'.

entityName.description: Name of the entity to search (e.g., 'Partners', 'Contacts').

vectorEmbedding.description: Optional vector embedding for direct semantic search.

whereCondition.description: Optional additional WHERE condition as a JSON array of objects, e.g., '[{"field": "status", "operator": "is", "value": "Active"}]'.

example_uses: Find partners similar to 'Acme Corp' where their status is 'Active'.
Search for contacts related to 'AI' with a similarity score above 0.8.
Retrieve documents semantically similar to 'project planning' that are marked as 'confidential' and created after '2023-01-01'.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user needs to find information based on semantic meaning or similarity across different entities, potentially combined with structured filtering criteria.

endpoints.name: GenerateTitle
endpoints.description: Generates a descriptive title for an AI assistant chat session based on its content, providing a concise summary.

sessionId.description: The unique identifier of the chat session for which to generate a title.

example_uses: Generate a title for session 'def-456'.
Create a summary title for my current chat.
Suggest a name for this conversation.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user wants the AI to automatically create a concise and relevant title for a chat session, often for better organization or quick reference.
